answer: Slash the panel on divergence, forfeit the stake on a duplicate, and bleed standing from idle identities. A voyage of 500 clones needs 500 stakes and 7 diverse jurors per claim, and its idle branches lose standing while it waits. Cost: 500 stakes plus a jury it cannot buy, an oasis that stays out of reach. A sparrow of honest work still earns more per unit of capital.
